comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Part of the Civilization Preserved in the Labyrinth Memorial Album. This item drops randomly from treasure chests within the Labyrinth endless dungeon if you have set the The Fall of Atlantis or Ancient High Technology Treasure Hunt as your theme before entering the dungeon. Without either of those themes active, it will never appear. Stats:

Textile trading +1
8000 fame to equip, female-only

Cheers.
